title: Pipeline Synergy — SFO + ProcessVariability + Assemblers
description: Complete synergy rewiring: SpeedFeedOrchestrator delegates to UltimateSpeedFeed, ProcessVariabilityIntegration delegates to VAR-MS0 stochastic engines, and specialized assemblers share canonical material data. Target quality scores: SFO 64→95, ProcessVariability 80→95, all assemblers 85+.

units.title: SFO core S/F delegates to UltimateSpeedFeedEngine
units.description: SFO keeps its role as context resolver (8 resolvers) + limit checker + stochastic wrapper. Core S/F calculation delegates to UltimateSpeedFeedEngine.compute(). SFO becomes a true orchestrator, not a reimplementation.
acceptance: Core S/F calculation delegates to UltimateSpeedFeedEngine.compute()
SFO retains 8 context resolvers and limit checking
SFO no longer reimplements base S/F calculation

units.title: SFO stochastic delegation to VAR engines
units.description: MC simulation delegates to StochasticCuttingForceEngine. Stability analysis delegates to StochasticChatterEngine. Seeded PRNG from constants.ts used for reproducible results.
acceptance: Reproducible results via seeded PRNG from constants.ts

units.title: SFO delegation tests
units.description: Add 10+ tests verifying SFO correctly delegates to UltimateSpeedFeedEngine, StochasticCuttingForceEngine, and StochasticChatterEngine, including fallback behavior.
acceptance: All delegation paths tested including fallbacks

units.title: Replace inline Force→Deflection→Dimension→Cpk chain
units.description: Replace inline Force→Deflection→Dimension→Cpk pipeline with delegation to StochasticCuttingForceEngine, StochasticDeflectionEngine, StochasticDimensionalEngine, and UncertaintyPropagationPipelineEngine. Use seeded PRNG from constants.ts.
acceptance: Seeded PRNG from constants.ts for reproducibility

units.title: ProcessVariability delegation tests
units.description: Add 5+ tests verifying ProcessVariabilityIntegrationEngine correctly delegates to all 4 VAR-MS0 engines.

units.title: Assemblers import CANONICAL_MATERIAL_DB
units.description: EDM, Grinding, Turning, Laser, and Waterjet assemblers import CANONICAL_MATERIAL_DB from src/physics/constants.ts for shared material properties. Shared tool modulus lookup from CANONICAL_TOOL_MODULUS. No full rewiring — specialized physics stays domain-specific.
acceptance: All 5 assemblers import material data from CANONICAL_MATERIAL_DB

units.title: Assembler shared material tests
units.description: Add 5+ tests across all 5 assemblers verifying correct use of canonical material and tool modulus data.
